name: Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe
description: Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe in Kassel, Germany, is a vast hillside park crowned by a giant statue of Hercules. From it, water tumbles down a 350-metre Grand Cascade, past grottoes and waterfalls, to a fountain that shoots 50 metres high. Begun in 1689 and shaped over roughly 150 years, the 2.4 square kilometre park is Europe's largest of its kind.
